info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Verifications API
Add & Validate an Email Address  Verify an OTP Code.

items.docs:
Take in `otpId` and code in the request body. It checks if the provided
code matches the one-time password generated for the OTP request and
returns the result. Does not require a minimum authentication standard.
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Add & Validate a Phone Number  Verify an OTP Code.

items.docs:
Add the `otpId` and code in the request body. It checks if the provided
code matches the one-time password generated for the OTP request and
returns the result. Does not require a minimum authentication standard.
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Retrieve the details of a document.

items.docs:
Informs if the document verification is still being processed or is
processed already. If `SUCCESS`, the document data is returned.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Add and Validate a Document - Retrieve the details of an additional document.

items.docs:
Informs if the document verification for the additional document is still being processed (PENDING)
or is processed already (SUCCESS). If SUCCESS, the document data is
returned.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Add and Validate a Document - Confirm the details of a document.

items.docs:
- After the user verifies and checks if the data extracted from the
documents match the current status (for example, Address).

- The user sends data back to MIDS to confirm the details.

- Perform verifications with IVPs and store the data into the PDS.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Add and Validate a Document - Resolve a conflict between identity attributes.

items.docs:
After the user verifies and confirms the conflict attribute, the user
sends data back to MIDS to confirm the details. This API will
perform verifications with IVPs and store the data into the PDS.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Add and Validate a Document - Confirm the identity was stored to the PDS.

items.docs:
Delete the document verification data on the Identity verification vendor
once the user confirms the PDS update.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Verifies the details of a medicare card document with an identity verification provider

params.name: issuing_country
params.description: Country of issue for the document in the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format, only AUS is an acceptable value for this parameter.

items.docs: Returns the status of the Medicare Card source verification as it's being processed by the vendor. Biometrics are not used with this API, which means document scanning is not required for the users to verify their identity. This will be a one-time verification with no data being stored.

info.name: Verifies the details of a passport document with an identity verification provider

params.name: issuing_country
params.description: Country of issue for the document in the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format, only AUS is an acceptable value for this parameter.

items.docs: Returns the Status of the Source Verification that has been processed by a trusted IVP.
